edits.current: Mandatory, nine integers. TWO RULES AND ONE TRAP. Rule one, the floor: 'el value minimo del collection debe ser de un (1) dia de un (1) SMLMV del ano accrued' - for accrual year 2026 one day of the SMMLV of COP 1,750,905 is COP 58,363.50, so a record below that is rejected. Rule two, the override: the layout's own formula is basic salary * (dias worked / 360) BUT 'en este campo el contributor puede especificar un value diferente y no se haran calculos automaticos de este value'. THE TRAP: the operator's formula omits the TRANSPORT ALLOWANCE, which CST art. 253 requires in the base. For an employee on the 2026 minimum wage the operator would compute 1,750,905 while the statute requires (1,750,905 + 249,095) = 2,000,000 - a shortfall of COP 249,095 that is a SHORT DEPOSIT, penalised at one day's salary for every day of delay under Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3, uncapped. ALWAYS write the engine's own figure into this field and never rely on the portal calculator. Where the monthly advance regime of MA01 is in use, this field carries the CONSOLIDATED annual figure and only the difference computed at MA05 is actually deposited in February. WHAT IS DEPOSITED - NET OF DIRECT PAYMENTS ALREADY MADE: T14 carries the amount actually deposited for the employee = the consolidated 31 December balance (IN01) LESS the lawful partial payments already made directly to the employee during the accrual year (CST art. 254; Population Rules Step 1 (f)) and LESS any direct payment of that balance made in January to an employee who left before the deposit, which is lawful under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4. An employee who left and was paid in full in the final settlement is not in the return at all (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (2)). Keep the gross annual liquidation as a separate engine value: System Mapping 'Cesantias_Annual_Liquidation' is the gross figure, T14 is the net deposit. Wage-type mapping: the February fund deposit is wage type 25827 / 65805 'Payment Severance Funds Inf.'. The consolidated 31 December balance is the absolute value of wage type 63814 'Severance Balance (Current Month)' in the January period; it is the annual liquidation ('ces base' 68040 x days / 360) less the in-year direct payments 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay' (paired with 62117 'Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay' for the interest). A January direct payment of part of that balance is wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year', and the deposit then carries the remainder: 25827 (February) + 62126 (January) = |63814| (January). A January direct payment to an employee who REMAINS in service reduces T14 only where it is a lawful partial payment under CST art. 254; a direct payment outside CST art. 254 does not reduce the deposit, and a full direct payment is handled through E92. Where the remainder after direct payments falls below the one-day SMMLV floor the channel rejects the record and the residue is settled with the employee (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (5)). The base 68040 exceeds the December basic salary 63807 wherever variable pay is averaged under CST art. 253, which is why T14 must never be left to the operator's basic-salary formula.

edits.current: CST art. 57 para. 4, added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, verbatim: 'Cuando el employer acredite de manera fehaciente el payment directo al employee del value correspondiente a las severance savings, dicho payment se considerara liberatorio de la obligacion, y no procedera sancion por no consignacion, salvo que se demuestre que el payment no se realizo en condiciones de libertad y que no fue utilizado en fines autorizados por la Law. No obstante, la afiliacion a Severance-savings fund es mandatory.' Three limits the engine must respect: the discharge needs FEHACIENTE evidence, it is rebuttable on the freedom-and-purpose test, and it does NOT remove the duty to affiliate the employee to a fund. A DRAFTING NOTE on the citation: art. 15's enacting formula announces only 'los paragrafos 2 y 3' of CST art. 57, yet the published text prints a Paragrafo 4 and this is it - so cite CST art. 57 para. 4 as added by Law 2466 of 2025 art. 15, and expect the discrepancy to be raised. Wage-type mapping of direct payments: during the year, wage type 62110 'Cash-out of Severance Pay'; in January, wage type 62126 'Advance Severance Last Year'; the fund deposit, wage type 25827, then carries the remainder of the balance. This flag covers a FULL discharge of the deposit obligation by proven direct payment (Population Rules Step 0 exclusion (4)). An employee who left and was paid directly in the final settlement is NOT an E92 case but a Step 0 exclusion (2) under Ley 50 de 1990 art. 99 num. 4, and a January direct payment to an employee who left before the deposit is treated as that lawful payment. A partial direct payment does not set E92 = Y: T14 carries the deposit net of the direct payments already made and the record is still produced. A January direct payment of part of the consolidated balance to an employee who REMAINS in service reduces T14 only where it is a lawful partial payment under CST art. 254; outside CST art. 254 it discharges the obligation only as a full direct payment with fehaciente evidence, in which case E92 = Y (see T14).
